covenants.quote: In order to protect the Confidential Information, the Recipient shall not, during the term of this Agreement and for a period of twelve (12) months after its termination, provide services similar to those contemplated by the Proposed Transaction to any Competitor.
covenants.impact: Restricts AtliQ from providing data analytics and reporting services to fintechs, NBFCs, and banks in India, which directly impacts active clients PayTrack Technologies and Trustline NBFC, as well as pipeline prospect FinEdge Bank.
